provenance.reference: Leirs et al. Scientific Data 2023, doi:10.1038/s41597-023-02700-3

repeat_capture_support.threshold: at least five initially MN-labeled, non-whitespace-colliding TOE identifiers with >=2 capture nights at valid grid stations 1..30 x A..J
repeat_capture_support.years: 1994–2023 inclusive, each one of the same MOSA site; temporal replication not independent sites

inference_boundary.frozen_primary_bout_definition: exactly three consecutive MN capture-bearing dates within one calendar month and m>=5
inference_boundary.author_occasion_structural_sensitivity: authors 363 exact 3-night sessions, including 59 crossing months, is not an automatic replacement of original frozen month filter
inference_boundary.next: Reproduce frozen conservative strict-month cohort on checksum-verified author first-species identities, then evaluate first-last MNA temporal variation and source identity without opening W/B. If not supported, STOP not change definition.
